similarities.point: Both define the thorax as the body region between the neck and the abdomen.
similarities.quote_britannica: THORAX, in anatomy. See Anatomy, p. 277.
similarities.quote_wikipedia: The thorax (pl.: thoraces or thoraxes) or chest is a part of the anatomy of mammals and other tetrapod animals located between the neck and the abdomen.

similarities.point: Both identify the thorax as one of the three main body divisions in insects.
similarities.quote_britannica: THORAX, in anatomy. See Anatomy, p. 277.
similarities.quote_wikipedia: In insects, crustaceans, and the extinct trilobites, the thorax is one of the three main divisions of the body, each in turn composed of multiple segments.

wiki_only_topics.quote_wikipedia: The human thorax includes the thoracic cavity and the thoracic wall. It contains organs including the heart, lungs, and thymus gland, as well as muscles and various other internal structures.
The word thorax comes from the Greek θώραξ thṓrax " breastplate, cuirass, corslet " via Latin: thorax.
Injury to the chest (also referred to as chest trauma, thoracic injury, or thoracic trauma) results in up to 1 / 4 of all deaths due to trauma in the United States.
In most insects, the thorax itself is composed of three segments; the prothorax, the mesothorax, and the metathorax.
